name: Team Italy Coffee Italian Ride
description:
Se cerchi la giusta compagnia per prepararti al fine settimana sei nel posto giusto.
Lo scopo della COFFEE ITALIAN RIDE è quello di stare tutti insieme, sfruttare la scia del gruppo e fare due chiacchiere al ritmo medio di 2.0 w/kg per 60 minuti, il late join è attivo per 30 minuti.
Questa NON è una gara.
Segui le istruzioni dei leader(giallo) per un gruppo compatto.
Ricordati di non superare la fence (barra rossa) altrimenti verrai eliminato.
Partecipa a questa ride per sbloccare la divisa del team italy.
BUONA PEDALATA A TUTTI
TEAM ITALY organizza una vasta gamma di eventi, tutti con le seguenti regole:
-in una pedalata di categoria D, alcuni ciclisti sono principianti, segui le istruzioni del
leader (logo giallo) che appaiono come testo al centro e tieni presente che il ritmo sarà di
circa 2 wkg
-Il valore WKG sarà diverso per tutti voi, il motivo principale sarà il peso, seguito dalla
capacità di utilizzare la scia e l'equipaggiamento della vostra bici in gioco
-abilitare i messaggi nelle opzioni zwift, fondamentali per una buona esperienza
-le pedalate della categoria D sono facili per un ciclista con C alto, 3wkg ftp, impegnative per un C basso, 2.5 wkg ftp, estreme per un ciclista D con 2 wkg FTP, lo stesso per le
corse C, facili per un A, 4wkg ftp, impegnative per B 3.2 wkg ftp, ed estreme per C con 2.5
wkg ftp.


Are you looking for the perfect companion and you are training for the weekend? This is the right place.

This is NOT A RACE.
Follow the leaders' instructions (yellow beacons) for keeping the group tight.
Remember the Fence is KILLER, 60 seconds over and you'll be out of the event.

- into a D category ride, some riders are beginners, follow the leader instructions (yellow
beacon) that appear as text in the middle and keep in mind that the pace will be around 2
wkg

capacity to use the draft and your ingame bike equipment

ftp, extreme for a D rider with 2 wkg FTP, same for C rides, easy for an A, 4 wkg ftp,

name: Zwift Crit Racing Club - Castle Crit
description:
It's Crit time! Come and join in the fun on a number of multi-lap short routes. Get ready to dig deep and push to the finish line!

What is Racing Score?

Racing Score is an intuitive system that replaces the traditional categories (A - D) with a 0-1000 scale to reflect your current level, considering various metrics like race performances and power. This score helps Zwift recommend the most competitive band to race in, ensuring a fun, rewarding, and exciting experience as you track your progression throughout your Zwift racing adventures.

WHAT IS ZWIFT POWER? For further information on connecting to Zwift Power check out this support page: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/connecting-to-zwiftpower-SyldRc_4H

name: Velos Sunny Side Up
description:
Time flies when you are having fun, but this is not a race, we just want to enjoy your company. Come and join team Velos for a D paced beginner friendly social spin for 60 minutes. Please pace with the yellow beacon at 1.5 - 1.8 w/kg. It’s a group ride so we encourage lots of chatter, maybe test you with some trivia questions and give you the opportunity to show off your pacing skills. Shout outs are given to those who catch the eye of the yellow beacon for riding close. Our supportive red beacon team will help any riders who drop behind to pace back to the yellow beacon if requested. Feel free to join in with the on screen chat, test your legs on a sprint or two or drop and help sweep at the back if your legs are strong. The fence may be used to encourage riders to work together and maximise the draft. Late join is available within the first 30 minutes and a Velos jersey is yours to keep if you complete the ride. We start and finish as a group and encourage all riders to look out for each other.

Come and try out Team Velos today and then be sure to see what other rides we host throughout the week. There is something for everybody and we guarantee a warm welcome.

Join Team Velos at. teamvelos.co.uk

Discord Channel. https://discord.gg/TDBE3FA

name: RCC Global Club Ride
description:
WELCOME TO THE RAPHA CYCLING CLUB WORLD WIDE GROUP RIDE. 
 
This is a social group workout; a chance every week for members to get together from around the globe, ride, chat and support each other - it’s run as a group workout session with ‘keep everyone together’ enabled so no matter what your pace you’ll stay in the pack - it’s not a race or competition and open for anyone to join us. 
We host 4 rides every week on a Tuesday to suit different time zones around the world (aimed at evenings), join whichever time works best for you. 
 
WHO IS THE RCC?
 
The Rapha Cycling Club (RCC) is, as the name suggests, Rapha’s Cycling Club. The RCC exists to help connect like minded riders from all over the world, underpinned by Rapha’s products and experiences. We ride together across continents and here united within Zwift. 
 
For more information head to: www.Rapha.cc/rcc
 
RIDE LEADERS
 
The rides are led by our friendly team of member ride leaders from around the world.  The Leader (who has a yellow beacon over their head) will ride at a steady pace as set by the workout session. Prompts will appear on screen set by the workout designer Matt Rowe so you know what to do throughout the ride. On most occasions we will have a support ride leader (who will also have a beacon), the ride leaders are there to help support you and keep the banter going - to join the chat use the Zwift Companion smartphone app. 
 
ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS
 
Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. That's right, if you're outputting 100W and another Zwifter is outputting 400W you will stay in exactly the same position relative to each other. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop.
 
ABOUT THIS WORKOUT

Today's workout contains 4 x 6 minute blocks of Zone 3, with some surges thrown in for good measure! The Zone 3 riding should feel nice and comfortable, however the surges may sting a little. The surges in each block are only 20 seconds long, but at 110% of FTP so require a focused increase in effort .At the end of each 6 minute block, there is a 1 minute 'Free Ride' - this is your chance to turn an endurance based session into something special! Come event day or when riding with friends, it's likely you want some more power for that final sprint to the cafe right? Give it 100% in each 60 second Free Ride section to help you become more explosive! Stress points 45: #Social
 
 
WORKOUT DESIGNER
 
Matt Rowe is the founder of Rowe & King Coaching (www.roweandking.com) with 25 years of cycling experience, coaching amateur cyclists all over the world to  achieve their personal goals.
 
HELPFUL HINT
 
We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests as the estimated FTP can be inaccurate and make the difficulty level of the workouts too high for your current fitness level.
You can adjust the difficulty of the workout mid-ride if needed, by using the up/down arrows on the left hand side, under the workout details.
 
HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

name: Escape Collective Tuesday Escapade
description:
Welcome to the Escape Collective Tuesday Escapade group ride, brought to you by friends of the Escape Collective (escapecollective.cc). It’s the same crew and ride format formerly known as “The Placeholder Tuesday Group Ride”.

This is a fun social group ride with the aim of enjoying riding in the bunch and having a bit of banter all with a touch of (optional) friendly competition.

Ride with our playlist, just search for “Escape Collective Zwift Playlist” on Spotify. Hit Play as the ride starts and enjoy the tunes.

Come along and ride with the crew where our ride leader will set a pace of up to 2.5w/kg after a slower warmup. Our course varies each week and most weeks will be a flat route to help keep the bunch together. Each ride will have a sweeper with a few other riders who are available to help any riders come back to the group if asked for assistance.

This is a social group ride not a race, so please respect the pace set by the ride leader. Stick together to enjoy the draft and companionship. The ride leader will not exceed the advertised pace at any time - even on hills. Please keep an eye on the leader beacon (yellow) and the sweeper beacon (red) to stay in the blob - flat, hilly or in between!

To keep things interesting, we offer optional opportunities for a sprint each lap followed by a regroup. Depending on the week we have 2 different ride formats:

- FIRST TUESDAY OF THE MONTH - Lap the Field - After riding the first half of the ride together as a group, the red beacon will lead an optional chase group at a hard pace (around 4w/kg) and attempt to lap riders in the main bunch. Whilst the chase is occurring the main bunch will continue to ride with the yellow ride leader at the usual pace of around 2.5 w/kg. It’s up to you – try and keep up with the faster bunch in red, or ride steady with yellow! In both cases, please try to stick with your chosen bunch.

- All OTHER WEEKS - Standard Short Race Format - Our final few kilometers will be an optional race to the end. The ride leader will let you know the exact start point in plenty of time.
Join our Zwift club to keep in touch with upcoming rides, chat with other participants outside the ride time, or if you'd like to get involved in running the ride! Search for "Friends of Escape Collective" in Zwift Companion's clubs interface.

Every week we drop a fresh, coach-built workout designed to fit naturally into an athlete’s real training rhythm. These aren’t static repeats. Sessions ebb and flow with the broader race season, shifting from early-season durability to midseason sharpening and late-season precision.
You can expect structure, intention, and just enough sting to make you better. Some Tuesdays bring controlled work, others bring a bit of fire, but every session has a purpose. TT bikes are allowed and Draft is enabled.
If you’re looking for a consistent weekly touchpoint that actually fits into a periodized training plan, this is it.

WORKOUT DESIGNER
All sessions are created by Dave D’Abrosca, owner and head coach of Power2Tri Endurance Coaching. Dave is a USAT Level II Long Course and Ironman Certified Coach with decades of experience guiding athletes through hundreds of races across triathlon, long course, XTERRA, gravel, MTB, and running events up to ultra distance.
Dave leads most sessions and designs each workout to support athletes who want structure, accountability, and high quality training that complements their real world goals.
The Power2Tri coaching team is available for questions at http://www.power2tri-endurance.com/.
Follow our daily training insights on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/power2tri.endurance
JOIN THE POWER2TRI ZWIFT CLUB
Our Zwift Club is the easiest way to find and join all Power2Tri events inside the Companion App. When you’re part of the club, upcoming rides surface automatically, making it simple to stay consistent with Terrible Tuesdays and any other sessions we host.
We also now have an official Power2Tri kit in Zwift, and Club members can unlock and ride in it during group events.
Join the club here:
https://www.zwift.com/clubs/5819a1e5-7af5-437f-aab7-287c169c0cb2/home

name: Film My Run 500 with NoblePro
description:
Join Stephen Cousins and NoblePro for a 500 metre climb. Set your treadmill to 12% incline and run 4.2km of distance to reach 500 metres elevation. If your treadmill doesn't go that high, set it as high as it will go and join us anyway!

The run will be progressive starting at a walking pace of 5kph rising to 7kph for the final kilometre. Get on to the balls of your toes and get your calf muscles to do the work. This continuous uphill effort will help build strength and endurance for those hilly trail runs

This event is sponsored by the ever popular Noble Pro treadmills. You can get a discount on a NoblePro SMART treadmill from this link https://zwift.run/noble-pro

You can watch the run on the live stream at http://youtube.com/ZwiftRunChannel

name: All American Bikes Ride presented by GRIT
description:
This is NOT a race, the ride will start with a warmup pace of 2.5 w/kg for all riders Yes, both A and B groups start together and stay together at the beginning! On flat sections near the start of the ride, we want both groups to stay together with a casual pace.

Join us for this social group ride. Our route will be a combination of flat sections and some big hills. The route will be selected to have 2 or 3 large hills during the ride.
Group A: Please join group A if you can maintain above 4.0 w/kg on short climbs.
Group B will be going uphill at 3.5 - 4.0 w/kg.
We want to increase the size of Group A. Please join group A if you are a strong group B rider. We want Group B to be riders that prefer 3.5 - 4.0 w/kg on climbs.
After hills, we will maintain 2 main groups. Group A riders that are in front of the group A leader should slow to rejoin the leader. Group B riders in front of the group B leader should slow to rejoin the leader. We ask for your cooperation to rejoin with your group to make this a fun social ride.

We welcome you to challenge yourself and join this ride even if you don't typically ride at this level. We often find riders join us and find that they can handle a higher intensity level by riding with a faster group.

GRIT: Great Rides for Intense Training

name: Team Valhalla Wake-up North America Ride
description:
Wake Up North America!!!
It’s time for a good early morning or lunchtime stretch ride brought to you by the friendly folks at Vikings and Team Valhalla.
Our fat burn, “no drop” ride is totally unique to Zwift……2 great paces making 1 amazing ride.
Feeling energetic? Then ride with the Yellow beacon at 1.8-2.5 w/kg. Feel like taking it down a bit? Then ride with the Red beacon at 1.6-1.8 w/kg. Feel like chasing? Then bounce back and forth between Yellow and Red. Everybody is included in our hour-long party.
Join us for our special theme rides and some in ride-challenges to tempt your riding skills. Every ride is a bit different, but you can count on making new friends and enjoying plenty of banter and jokes each week. The only rule we have is to HAVE FUN!!

name: GGCC Glasgow Green Cycle Club Tuesday Training Ride
description:
The Glasgow Green Cycle Club GGCC group rides are training and/or social events, category C or D, with a Yellow beacon leader and Red beacon sweeper.

Please look out for our training rides on several days every week. Use #GGCC to search, as in https://zwift.com/events/tag/ggcc, or on Companion.

You should ride as a group, following the instructions of the beacon ride leader(s) for any sprints, intervals and spicy segments, regrouping after each when requested. Our lap or distance-limited group rides also have a closing minirace, to start from behind the Yellow beacon. Our 1-hour rides don’t close with a minirace.

GGCC is a Glasgow-based cycling club whose “in real life” (irl) club runs and training rides are always organised into pace groups, which match the Zwift categories quite well. 

As we expect our club’s riders to be able to ride 50 miles at a 15mph average on our Sunday rides, such steady riding members will be comfortable with Zwift Category C or D. Beacon leaders communicate via Zwift on-screen messaging (always) and/or Discord via your headset to vary the pace to allow for sprints, intervals, and optionally a mini-race towards the end of our lap or distance limited rides, with regrouping after each segment. Make as much use of drafting as you can, for more effective sprinting and intervals.

Results can be seen at the end of the ride on screen, and we publish your results on zwiftpower.com too, based on each category.

All bikes and PUs are allowed, but better not to use TT bikes (which don’t draft) on our group rides. Please add GGCC (X) to your Zwift name to allow your ride presence to be recognised, where X is your desired ride category. Categories are related to your Functional Threshold Power (FTP); use your FTP and then divide by your weight in kg, then pick the correct ride and group.

Category D: 2 W/kg to 2.5 W/kg FTP. The beacon leader will ride to 2.5w/kg pace average or below.
Category C: 2.6 W/kg to 3.2 W/kg FTP. The beacon leader will ride to 3.2w/kg pace average or below.

PLEASE NOTE: Strava data for our rides must be open (not private or hidden). Please use a heart monitor so that we can monitor correlated power and heart rate to help assure fair riding.

You can use our GGCC Discord channel to talk to each other at https://discord.gg/UDhdEQA.

Please see the GGCC Zwift page link at http://www.glasgowgreencycleclub.co.uk/ for more.

For more about specific Zwift courses for our events, see the Zwift Companion schedule, and also https://zwiftinsider.com/ where there is a wealth of information about all things Zwift.

#ggcc

name: CRYO-GEN Power Tuesday Group Ride
description:
Power Tuesday. The TGR Ride is a ride that has been organized for the many riders in the Zwift Community who wish to have a paced ride with friends and like-minded members of the community. The ride has been organised as a workout ride and will incorporate intervals.
 
If you are a stronger rider who has joined the group to possibly support others or to support a friend you can help the group Leader and others by watching the back of the group for any rider struggling to stay with the main group and assist if needed.

These events are held to assist with the attainment of your training goals and will include intervals over and below the ride average parameters. This is not a race so please follow the leader beacon's (Yellow) instructions and if you are feeling strong, please help the sweeper beacon (Red) to assist other riders back to the pack. 

The pace will be kept at a manageable level to attempt to have all riders finish together. 
We will endeavor to have as many Sweepers as possible to assist any rider who is struggling.

There are no rules apart from enjoy the ride and try not to ride ahead of the group leader.

HEALTH: We would advise any rider who is attempting a Zwift ride for the first time to, ensure that their health should always take precedence over completing any ride. If you feel unwell or unable to continue please STOP 
NOTE: Exercise contributes to 25% weight loss; Healthy Eating (Not Diet) contributes to the other 75%. Be fit and Healthy.

name: ROAD TO ZWIFT RACING LEAGUE
description:
Team up. Show up. Race together.

Zwift Racing League is team racing at its best: fast, sweaty, and addictive. Race alongside your teammates every Tuesday, combining teamwork, tactics, and competition with the kind of Type 2 Fun that keeps you coming back for more.

The 2026/27 season features four 6-week rounds from September to April, with new routes, a new format, XP rewards, and exclusive unlocks along the way. Round 1 gets underway on September 22.

YOUR ROAD TO ZRL STARTS HERE

Thinking about racing ZRL? This group ride is designed to show you what it’s all about and help you get ready for the start line.
Ride alongside other Zwifters as we introduce you to team racing, what to expect when you race ZRL, and how to take the next step and join a team.

There’s no racing today. Just ride with the group, learn more about ZRL, and get ready to race together.

READY TO RACE?

Once you've completed the ride, the next step is to find your team and get signed up.

Getting started is simple:

1 - Create your WTRL profile by connecting your Zwift account.
2 - Visit the ZRL Find a Team page for ways to find a team.
3 - Or register your own team and invite your friends.

REGISTER NOW
https://www.wtrl.racing/zwift-racing-league/

name: DWGZ — Who Let the DWGZ Out?
description:
DWGZ — Who Let the DWGZ Out?!

Welcome to DWGZ (Determined Witty Gritty Zwifters) — a global crew of cyclists who show up with grit, humor, heart, and the kind of energy that lifts the whole group. Many of us have zwifted together for years, and some have taken those virtual connections IRL, organizing meetups around the world. DWGZ builds more than fitness — we build community, emotional endurance, and the kind of camaraderie that makes even the hardest efforts feel lighter through shared suffering.

Who Let the DWGZ Out?! is our punchy, higher-energy Tuesday session — typically featuring a KOM climb segment, steady pressure, and the signature DWGZ vibe: gritty, supportive, and full of good watts and better banter.

Whether you're chasing fitness gains, sharpening your endurance, or just want to ride with people who make suffering fun, this one's for you.

Ride Categories 🚴 B Category – 3.2–4.0 w/kg 🚴 C Category – 2.8–3.2 w/kg 🚴 D Category – 2.0–2.6 w/kg

Expect steady pressure, smooth rotation, and a welcoming group from yellow beacon to sweep. Every pocket of the ride is built on teamwork, connection, and that signature DWGZ vibe.

DWGZ rides run seven days a week at 6:05 AM Eastern (US) — each one an opportunity to build strength, connection, and global community.
Clip in, let the watts loose, and howl into Tuesday with us.

name: OutSeason with Endurance Nation
description:
Get stronger on the bike this winter in two hours a week.

You’ll head into next season with more strength, endurance, and power than base miles alone can give you, and you’ll build it on two focused one-hour rides a week. Tuesday and Thursday are the quality sessions. When work or life gets in the way, Saturday is your make-up day, so a busy week doesn’t cost you the progress.

This is the first 9 weeks of Endurance Nation’s OutSeason cycling series, and it’s not an experiment. More than 10,000 cyclists and triathletes have used it over the last 20 years to show up in the spring faster than they left in the fall.

Spend this winter on targeted work and see what it does for your next season. Learn more at www.endurancenation.us/outseason.

name: The Ride For Mental Health
description:
Let’s ride away the stigma!

The Ride For Mental Health (TRFMH) was started to support a community dedicated to eliminating the stigma of mental illness through education and open conversation.

This event is inspired by Eric Dorris, who suffered from borderline personality disorder and other disorders. His dad, Mac Dorris, founded TRFMH as a way to find hope, healing and purpose after Eric’s sudden and tragic death.

The Ride For Mental Health has emerged as the premier cycling fundraiser in the U.S. exclusively benefitting mental health. The proceeds raised will be donated to McLean Hospital, a Harvard Medical School affiliate, for the education, research and treatment of mental illness including anxiety, borderline personality disorder, depression, eating disorders and substance abuse.

IMPORTANT: You need to create an account at Leadout and link it to your Zwift account to show up in race results.

Because the goal is for you to hold your max power for the duration of each race, these are set up as mass-start time trial events. Drafting is disabled, so there's no 'sitting in.' Categories are based on your compound score, which takes into account your 5-minute power and body weight, computed as (5-min power in W/kg) * (5-min power in W). Current category setup:

- A: 1600+
- B: 1200-1600
- C: 900-1200
- D: 900 and below

name: RCC Global Club Ride
description:
WELCOME TO THE RAPHA CYCLING CLUB WORLD WIDE GROUP RIDE. 
 
This is a social group workout; a chance every week for members to get together from around the globe, ride, chat and support each other - it’s run as a group workout session with ‘keep everyone together’ enabled so no matter what your pace you’ll stay in the pack - it’s not a race or competition and open for anyone to join us. 
We host 4 rides every week on a Tuesday to suit different time zones around the world (aimed at evenings), join whichever time works best for you. 
 
WHO IS THE RCC?
 
The Rapha Cycling Club (RCC) is, as the name suggests, Rapha’s Cycling Club. The RCC exists to help connect like minded riders from all over the world, underpinned by Rapha’s products and experiences. We ride together across continents and here united within Zwift. 
 
For more information head to: www.Rapha.cc/rcc
 
RIDE LEADERS
 
The rides are led by our friendly team of member ride leaders from around the world.  The Leader (who has a yellow beacon over their head) will ride at a steady pace as set by the workout session. Prompts will appear on screen set by the workout designer Matt Rowe so you know what to do throughout the ride. On most occasions we will have a support ride leader (who will also have a beacon), the ride leaders are there to help support you and keep the banter going - to join the chat use the Zwift Companion smartphone app. 
 
ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS
 
Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. That's right, if you're outputting 100W and another Zwifter is outputting 400W you will stay in exactly the same position relative to each other. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop.
 
ABOUT THIS WORKOUT

Today's workout contains 4 x 6 minute blocks of Zone 3, with some surges thrown in for good measure! The Zone 3 riding should feel nice and comfortable, however the surges may sting a little. The surges in each block are only 20 seconds long, but at 110% of FTP so require a focused increase in effort .At the end of each 6 minute block, there is a 1 minute 'Free Ride' - this is your chance to turn an endurance based session into something special! Come event day or when riding with friends, it's likely you want some more power for that final sprint to the cafe right? Give it 100% in each 60 second Free Ride section to help you become more explosive! Stress points 45: #Social
 
 
WORKOUT DESIGNER
 
Matt Rowe is the founder of Rowe & King Coaching (www.roweandking.com) with 25 years of cycling experience, coaching amateur cyclists all over the world to  achieve their personal goals.
 
HELPFUL HINT
 
We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests as the estimated FTP can be inaccurate and make the difficulty level of the workouts too high for your current fitness level.
You can adjust the difficulty of the workout mid-ride if needed, by using the up/down arrows on the left hand side, under the workout details.
 
HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

name: The Grind Finale
description:
ABOUT THIS WORKOUT

This session aims to replicate the demands of a mountain bike ride / event. 

Mountain biking generally involves far more variations in effort compared with road riding - so plenty of surges and time spent being over geared! We also spend a lot of time on and off the power, so short spells going  hard to get over an obstacle, followed by a freewheel or very low power on a descent or little dip.

We touch upon all of these aspects in todays session, as we start off alternating every 30 seconds between riding hard at a low cadence, and riding easy - as if we are riding through an undulating single track. Then we make a ramp in effort, which finishes with a 30 second near max effort up a steep, rocky banking!

WORKOUT DESIGNER

Matt Rowe - Heavily involved in cycling for the past 25 years, Matt represented Great Britain at the Junior World Championships before graduating to the pro ranks. Matt draws on his extensive race experience to help amateur cyclists around the world achieve their personal goals. 

ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS

Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. That's right, if you're outputting 100W and another Zwifter is outputting 400W you will stay in exactly the same position relative to each other. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop. 

We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests as the estimated FTP can be inaccurate and make the difficulty level of the workouts too high for your current fitness level. For more info on FTP go to: https://support.zwift.com/hc/en-us/articles/210208083-What-is-FTP-and-how-is-it-used-in-Zwift

name: OutSeason with Endurance Nation
description:
Get stronger on the bike this winter in two hours a week.

You’ll head into next season with more strength, endurance, and power than base miles alone can give you, and you’ll build it on two focused one-hour rides a week. Tuesday and Thursday are the quality sessions. When work or life gets in the way, Saturday is your make-up day, so a busy week doesn’t cost you the progress.

This is the first 9 weeks of Endurance Nation’s OutSeason cycling series, and it’s not an experiment. More than 10,000 cyclists and triathletes have used it over the last 20 years to show up in the spring faster than they left in the fall.

Spend this winter on targeted work and see what it does for your next season. Learn more at www.endurancenation.us/outseason.

name: Zwift TT Club Racing - Urumaze
description:
The Time Trial. Cycling’s true leveler - just you and your legs versus everyone else in the field.

Come join Zwift TT Club on Zwift for more Time Trial event information! https://www.zwift.com/clubs/b3d1a903-df49-44eb-9c6f-4ba9f0622efe/home

Join us as we embark on a series of events - each week you will have multiple chances to set your best time on the same route!

Over the course of the series, we’ll be using routes in the region of 15-25km.

Check out Zwiftpower.com after your event to see how well you stack up against the competition!

Don’t forget to check you’re using the fastest bike frame and wheels available to you!

WHAT IS ZWIFT POWER? 
For further information on connecting to Zwift Power check out this support page: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/connecting-to-zwiftpower-SyldRc_4H 

Please note; for your results to show up in Zwift Power you must be using a Heart Rate Monitor (HRM) and be riding on a smart trainer, smart bike, or using a power meter.

name: Nosco Foundation Social Ride p/b Liv Cycling
description:
The Nosco Foundation Ride p/b Liv is all about community, hope, and love! Why? That's what the Michael P. Nosco Foundation is all about! And we can spread that by riding bikes on Zwift? Of course! Join us every week on Tuesday at 6:30am PT for a fun, social ride appropriate for all levels. Laugh and smile as you pedal along with ride leaders Jack Nosco, Janel Spilker and other Nosco Sherpas. 

Together with the team at Liv Cycling, we hope this ride serves as motivation to get on your bike, a chance to invite friends to join in good healthy fun, and spread the love, hope, and community that embodies the Nosco Foundation.

About the Foundation:

The Michael P. Nosco Foundation's mission is to provide financial relief to families and/or individuals who are confronting a life threatening illness. The foundation's mission is realized by organizing an annual cycling event held on November 3rd, affectionately known as the Nosco Ride, that brings together 1000+ cyclists from all over the world to ride in support of these families. The end result? In addition to the funds raised and donated to the recipients, the Nosco Ride provides long-lasting hope, love, and community. 

Learn more at https://mikenosco.com/

name: Lance Watson's Champion Intervals
description:
Join this custom designed interval workout by Hall of Fame Coach Lance Watson! Accomplish the same style of workout Coach Watson prescribed to win Ironman, Olympic Gold, and countless age group championships. Our Tuesday rides focus on threshold work to ensure quality Zone 4 energy zones are part of your training week. This challenging 60 minute ride is live-coached by Lance and is guaranteed to make you a stronger cyclist. The rides are banded and all levels are welcome - we’ll all stick together.

About Lance Watson: Lance Watson is a Triathlon Hall of Fame coach who has coached at numerous World Championships and four Olympic Games. An Ironman Master Coach, Lance specializes in coaching athletes of all abilities with busy life schedules who want the most out of their available training time. Lance is the founder and owner of LifeSport Coaching in Victoria, Canada and the innovator behind Lance Watson’s TRiCLUB, the first online club that offers structured team workouts and live, interactive coaching sessions using Zoom and Zwift. For more information visit www.lifesportcoaching.com. For a free coaching consult, book a call at https://calendly.com/lifesport-triclub/30min

name: Le Col SUB6 Endurance Series
description: Starting on Tuesday 22nd October at 06:30 MST, join RAAM World Record Holder Lucas Clarke for the Le Col SUB6 Endurance Series on Zwift. These weekly sessions are crafted to help you develop your endurance capacity.  Whether you’re preparing for ultra-distance events like Race Across America (RAAM), Transcontinental and Mallorca 312, aiming for your first ultra or looking to refine your training, this series is your key to mastering endurance.

name: Team DRAFT Tuesday Race
description:
Welcome to the Tuesday Race brought to you by Team DRAFT!
We encourage that all participants head over to zwiftpower.com and register. For more information see: https://zwiftinsider.com/zwiftpower-signup/ Riders who have not completed the Zwiftpower registration will not be included in the official race results. We also ask that your Zwift activities be saved publicly, and that you open and maintain a Strava account to allow for organizer analysis. Any rider exhibiting questionable performance during a the race may be disqualified.

RULES:
- No zPower riders.
- Heart rate monitors mandatory for all categories
- 5min and 20min CEVAZ limits apply. Riding in the wrong category will lead to disqualification.

RACE CATEGORIES:
A: 4.0 W/kg to 5.0 W/kg
B: 3.2 W/kg to 3.99 W/kg
C: 2.5 W/kg to 3.19 W/kg
D: Under 2.49 W/kg

name: Stanga Racing after work crit
description:
Shake off the workday with the Stanga Racing After Work Crit. Short, sharp and full gas from the gun – expect 20–30 minutes of surges, corners and sprint finishes with the Stanga crew. Join your category, hold your line, and race fair. This is all about hard efforts, clean racing and good vibes. Grab your best crit setup, warm up well, and let’s see who clocks out on top.

Like this format? Join the Stanga Racing club on Zwift for our full weekly schedule of crits, punchy races, and endurance rides.

description:
It's Crit time! Come and join in the fun on a number of multi-lap short routes. Get ready to dig deep and push to the finish line!

What is Racing Score?

Racing Score is an intuitive system that replaces the traditional categories (A - D) with a 0-1000 scale to reflect your current level, considering various metrics like race performances and power. This score helps Zwift recommend the most competitive band to race in, ensuring a fun, rewarding, and exciting experience as you track your progression throughout your Zwift racing adventures.

description:
Come and join the fastest growing running club on Zwift.  With a choice of 5 or 10k you can pick your distance. Whether you are a beginner or experienced runner come and join us, you can run at whatever pace you like, it’s not a race unless you want it to be!

Each day is a different route and as new routes are released the courses will change to allow you to bag that badge.

You will run in our in game NPRC jersey and if you complete the event you get to keep it to wear wherever you like.

We also hold special events where you can win an actual jersey to wear in real life.

NPRC Facebook – We have a facebook group where you can join and talk about all things running.  Share your stories and get help and advice.

We create treadmills loved by runners and the wider running community for quality engineered hardware features and advanced software integration to give you the freedom to train with the apps you love.
https://www.noble-pro.com/

name: Braunstein Cycling Club Danish Group Ride
description:
This is a social group workout; a chance every week for members to get together from around the globe, ride, chat and support each other - it’s run as a group workout session with ‘keep everyone together’ enabled so no matter what your pace you’ll stay in the pack - it’s not a race or competition and open for anyone to join us.

WHO IS THE BCC?

The BRAUNSTEIN Cycling Club (BCC) is, as the name suggests, Braunstein brewery’s Cycling Club. The BCC is a danish social Cycling club were we share our passion for Cycling.

For more information head to: www.braunstein.dk/bcc2

RIDE LEADERS

The rides are led by our friendly team of member ride leaders. The Leader (who has a yellow beacon over their head) will ride at a steady pace as set by the workout session. On most occasions we will have a support ride leader (who will also have a beacon), the ride leaders are there to help support you and keep the banter going - to join the chat use the Zwift Companion smartphone app.

Map/Route — Wattopia
Distance/Time/Laps — 1 hour
Type of Event - Group Ride
ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS

Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop.

name: ROAD TO ZWIFT RACING LEAGUE
description:
Team up. Show up. Race together.

Zwift Racing League is team racing at its best: fast, sweaty, and addictive. Race alongside your teammates every Tuesday, combining teamwork, tactics, and competition with the kind of Type 2 Fun that keeps you coming back for more.

The 2026/27 season features four 6-week rounds from September to April, with new routes, a new format, XP rewards, and exclusive unlocks along the way. Round 1 gets underway on September 22.

YOUR ROAD TO ZRL STARTS HERE

Thinking about racing ZRL? This group ride is designed to show you what it’s all about and help you get ready for the start line.
Ride alongside other Zwifters as we introduce you to team racing, what to expect when you race ZRL, and how to take the next step and join a team.

There’s no racing today. Just ride with the group, learn more about ZRL, and get ready to race together.

READY TO RACE?

Getting started is simple:

1 - Create your WTRL profile by connecting your Zwift account.
2 - Visit the ZRL Find a Team page for ways to find a team.
3 - Or register your own team and invite your friends.

REGISTER NOW

name: Outseason Tuesdays with Endurance Nation

Transform Your Winter with Endurance Nation’s OutSeason Program!

Get ready to build next-level fitness with our 9-week OutSeason cycling series! Join us every Tuesday and Thursday for a focused, one-hour session designed to boost your strength, endurance, and power. With just two workouts per week, you’ll start building winter strength that will prepare you to reach your goals next season. This program is tried-and-true, with over 10,000 athletes using it to succeed in cycling and triathlon for over 16 years.

Why settle for base miles alone when you can add targeted intensity this winter? Join Endurance Nation and see what a season of smart training can do. Discover more about the OutSeason at www.endurancenation.us/zwift.

Love these workouts? Check out the club for more opportunities to train with us! We offer social rides on Saturdays, Sundays and Mondays each week — they are great alternates to these scheduled workouts!

These workouts were built to help strengthen athletes of all abilities and help build for race day. All of the workouts use your 10K speed bias setting in Zwift -- this pace time can be adjusted in settings to increase/decrease level of difficulty. Need More Speed? If you're looking for an additional speed workout during the week you're welcome to join us for Thursday Dusk Patrol which starts at same time (8:30AM MT/10:30AM ET).

ABOUT

ABOUT Jordan Maddocks
I'm a low 2:30's marathoner fighting out of Draper, Utah, USA. I’ve been running for over 15 years. Running is my passion, It's what keeps me centered and where I find solace. I love coaching and assisting others in setting their fitness goals and achieving them. I've been hosting Dusk Patrol on Zwift for over three years. When I'm not training I'm spending time with my momma bear and two cubs. Running has the magical ability to assist others in finding their greatness and I hope I can share that journey with you.

name: NORDIC CHASE – DOUBLE DRAFT
description:
CAN YOU STAY AWAY – OR CAN YOU CATCH THEM?

Nordic Chase is a twice-weekly staggered-start chase race. All five Zwift Racing Score groups race the same route and finish line, but the lower-score groups start first and the faster groups chase from behind. When riders are caught, they may try to jump onto the faster group's wheels and continue in the draft. The intended overall winner is the first rider across the finish line, regardless of category. Category results may also be shown.

name: DBR Tuesday Race
description:
Welcome to DBR Tuesday Race.
All will start with 1 minute between RS categories. Expect each race to be highly competitive and have fun.
Categories
Each race will be using Zwift Racing Score (ZRS) for categorization.
race up a category, if your RS is at the top end of a category. Or if you simply desire an added challenge.
- A: 1000 =< 690
- B:690<520
- C:520<350
- D:350<180
- E:180<=0
Your Zwift Racing Score is determined by how much success you have in races.
better against people with higher ZRS, then your ZRS may increase. If you place worse than people with lower ZRS, then your score might decrease. Read more about ZRS here - https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh <https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh>
If your ZRS increases past a category boundary during the series, your points earned will not transfer to the new category with you.
RULES:
Smart trainer or power meter is required. zPower will be removed.
Heart rate monitors are compulsory for all categories.
No TT bikes unless it's a TT event.
You need to have a registered account with Zwiftpower.com and accept their terms and conditions to be in the results of the race.
Misc.
Race organizers may request riders in all categories to provide a dual recording or a matching RL effort (Strava) in order to verify a Zwift race effort. Failure to comply may result in disqualification from the event. Failure to provide a dual recording or RL effort on three requests may result in disqualification from future events, until a dual recording with a matching effort is provided.
Race organizers may exclude a rider from the results, due to poor sportsmanship. Examples may be bad language, sandbagging or other behavior of a disruptive manner.

Team up. Show up. Race together.

Zwift Racing League is team racing at its best: fast, sweaty, and addictive. Race alongside your teammates every Tuesday, combining teamwork, tactics, and competition with the kind of Type 2 Fun that keeps you coming back for more.

The 2026/27 season features four 6-week rounds from September to April, with new routes, a new format, XP rewards, and exclusive unlocks along the way. Round 1 gets underway on September 22.

YOUR ROAD TO ZRL STARTS HERE

Thinking about racing ZRL? This group ride is designed to show you what it’s all about and help you get ready for the start line.
Ride alongside other Zwifters as we introduce you to team racing, what to expect when you race ZRL, and how to take the next step and join a team.

name: Team Africa Rising
description:
The Team Africa Rising Zwift Ride showcases our efforts in African cycling development. On this ride, you may be joined by some of our African cyclists from around the continent including Benin, Sierra Leone, Rwanda, DRC (Congo), and Uganda. Enjoy all the different African flags! You may even ride with former Rwandan Olympian (2012/2016) and World Tour cyclist (Team DiData), Adrien Niyonshuti.

We use this ride as a training and recovery ride for our African cyclists. We have Benin coaches who use this ride to train new Benin cyclists on how to shift, stay with the peloton and establish a consistent pedal stroke. So, you’ll be part of history during this ride! This event is run by members of Team Africa Rising, Adrien Niyonshuti, and all the up-and-coming coaches and cyclists of Benin and other countries to help them better learn to engage with fans and other riders. Sometimes we’ll have guest leads to talk to you about our work with Team Africa Rising.

The ride will remain a D+/C- ride. The team will adhere to the 1.5 - 2.0 w/kg range. The lead will ride at the top end, the sweep will ride at the lower end and will help riders if they want to make it back to the pack.

On this ride, we encourage chatting as it teaches the riders English. YOU will be a part of helping these young men and women build and lead their own rides. How cool is that?

You can follow us on our Facebook Page: https://www.facebook.com/groups/teamafricarising

Learn more about Team Africa Rising on our website: https://teamafricarising.org

name: EVO CC Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO race series. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

#evo

description:
This hill climb TT is a race without draft, but bike can be
freely chosen. The race is for everyone who wants a good, high quality
workout and competition with likeminded people. Remember to pace yourself,
there will be a climb to conquer. The race should be as fair as possible so
the following rules apply. Racers on zPower, lacking heart rate monitors,
riding in an inappropriate category, or riding very unrealistically will be
disqualified. Powerups are turned off as well. Final results will be
available on zwiftpower.com. So get your bottles and turn on your fan, get
ready for some great fun! When you sign up please select the correct
category below (your FTP divided by your weight in kg):
(A) 4.0+ W/kg FTP
(B) 3.2 - 3.99 W/kg FTP
(C) 2.5 - 3.19 W/kg FTP
(D) 0 - 2.49 W/kg FTP
(E) Women Only

name: Chaser the Pacer!
description:
This is a different type of chase event.

Everyone has to complete one lap of Mountain Mash - only 5.7km.

Every category is led by a Robo Pacer, configured so that their power output is at the top end of the pace group. They are all set up so that they should finish *extremely* closely together.

Jump into your category and try to keep up with the pacer and see how near to the front you finish!

name: The Herd Gallops
description:
Looking to push the pace a little before The Herd's Tuesday Social? All are welcome to join The Herd on this supportive and social event.  Respect the leader's pace and ride with the yellow beacon. Although this is a faster paced ride, it is NOT A RACE! Stronger riders are encouraged to fall back and help sweep the riders struggling in the back.                                                                                 

The average pace for the ride with be 2.7-3.2 but will go up to 3.5-4WKG on climbs.

This season we will ramp up the pace every 3 weeks throughout the winter until we reach the goal of 2.7-3.2 for a hour. 

Join us on Discord during the ride: https://discord.gg/Dr7ZtPV (Please use Push-To-Talk)

name: Film My Run 500 with NoblePro
description:
Join Stephen Cousins and NoblePro for a 500 metre climb. Set your treadmill to 12% incline and run 4.2km of distance to reach 500 metres elevation. If your treadmill doesn't go that high, set it as high as it will go and join us anyway!

The run will be progressive starting at a walking pace of 5kph rising to 7kph for the final kilometre. Get on to the balls of your toes and get your calf muscles to do the work. This continuous uphill effort will help build strength and endurance for those hilly trail runs

This event is sponsored by the ever popular Noble Pro treadmills. You can get a discount on a NoblePro SMART treadmill from this link https://zwift.run/noble-pro

You can watch the run on the live stream at http://youtube.com/ZwiftRunChannel

name: NonStop Madrid-Lisboa Race Day
description:
EVENTOS NON STOP MADRID – LISBOA RACE DAY
Bienvenidos a NON STOP MADRID – LISBOA RACE DAY
Esta CARRERA es ofrecida por el evento por etapas de MTB NON STOP MADRID - LISBOA para que puedas superarte día a día. Una carrera de BTT que te permitirá vivir una aventura de 700 km desde Madrid a Lisboa.
Espera una CARRERA montañosa y competitiva en todas las CATs. Para que la carrera sea lo más justa posible, los corredores que utilicen zPower, que carezcan de monitores de frecuencia cardíaca, que pedaleen en una categoría inapropiada o que pedaleen de manera poco realista pueden ser descalificados.
Los resultados finales estarán disponibles en zwiftpower.com. Esperamos que todos los participantes disfruten de la CARRERA, realicen un ENTRENAMIENTO de calidad y tengan la oportunidad de sentir los valores AVENTUREROS del NON STOP MADRID - LISBOA.
Si deseas obtener más información sobre el evento, síguenos en nuestra cuenta de Instagram https://www.instagram.com/nonstopmadridlisboa/ y echa un vistazo a nuestro sitio web shorturl.at/irNRW.
Un desafío increíble para los amantes de la bicicleta de montaña. Más de 700kms en una aventura que te dejará sin palabras. #NonStopMadridLisboa #rideon #RideMtbRaces #AbrazaLaAdventura

CATEGORIAS

Grupo A: 4.0-5.0 w/kg
Grupo B: 3.2-3.9 w/kg
Grupo C: 2.5-3.1 w/kg
Grupo D: 1.0-2.49 w/kg
Grupo E: categoría femenina 1.0-5.0 w/kg


Welcome to NON STOP MADRID – LISBOA RACE DAY
 
This RACE is offered by the MTB NON STOP MADRID - LISBON stage event to help you improve yourself day by day. A mountain bike race that will allow you to live a 700 km adventure from Madrid to Lisbon.

Expect a competitive, hilly RACE in all CATs. To keep the race as fair as possible, riders using zPower, lacking heart rate monitors, riding in an inappropriate category, or riding unrealistically may be disqualified.

Final results will be available on zwiftpower.com. We hope that all participants enjoy the RACE, do a quality TRAINING and have the opportunity to feel the ADVENTURER values ​​of NON STOP MADRID - LISBON.

For more information about the event, follow us on our Instagram account https://www.instagram.com/nonstopmadridlisboa/ and take a look at our website shorturl.at/xCKNV.

An incredible challenge for mountain bike lovers. More than 700kms in an adventure journey that will leave you speechless. #NonStopMadridLisboa #rideon #RideMtbRaces #EmbraceAdventure

name: RCM Tuesday Winter Ride | 60-min Workout + 60-min Rider's Choice
description:
Join Radsportclub Magdeburg e.V. for our weekly winter Zwift ride!
First 60 minutes: a moderate FTP-based endurance and tempo workout: 10-min warm-up (50-60% FTP), 10 min at 70%, 3 x 5 min at 80% with 5-min recovery blocks at 65%, and 10 min at 60% FTP.
Next 60 minutes: Rider's Choice / Free Ride at your own pace (ERG off). All abilities welcome. We want the group to stay together for the whole 120 minutes, including the Free Ride block.

name: ROAD TO ZWIFT RACING LEAGUE
description:
Team up. Show up. Race together.

Zwift Racing League is team racing at its best: fast, sweaty, and addictive. Race alongside your teammates every Tuesday, combining teamwork, tactics, and competition with the kind of Type 2 Fun that keeps you coming back for more.

The 2026/27 season features four 6-week rounds from September to April, with new routes, a new format, XP rewards, and exclusive unlocks along the way. Round 1 gets underway on September 22.

YOUR ROAD TO ZRL STARTS HERE

Thinking about racing ZRL? This group ride is designed to show you what it’s all about and help you get ready for the start line.
Ride alongside other Zwifters as we introduce you to team racing, what to expect when you race ZRL, and how to take the next step and join a team.

There’s no racing today. Just ride with the group, learn more about ZRL, and get ready to race together.

READY TO RACE?

Once you've completed the ride, the next step is to find your team and get signed up.

Getting started is simple:

1 - Create your WTRL profile by connecting your Zwift account.
2 - Visit the ZRL Find a Team page for ways to find a team.
3 - Or register your own team and invite your friends.

REGISTER NOW
https://www.wtrl.racing/zwift-racing-league/

name: PUMP: Loop Logic II — Tuesday (2 Laps)
description:
Same Distance. More Laps. Maximum Sass. ♥️🌶️

Welcome to Loop Logic, the weekday series where we prove that "going in circles" is actually a superpower. We’ve curated a week of routes that hit the 19–25km sweet spot with enough climbing to keep your glutes talking back to you.

The Logic is Simple:
We start with one big loop on Monday and add a lap every day until Friday. One lap is a warm-up, but five laps is a statement.

The PUMP Vibe:
Power in Numbers: No band here, ladies! This is your chance to find your rhythm, tuck into a friendly draft, and realize you’re much faster than you think.

Elevation is Our Love Language: Expect at least 100m of climb—just enough to feel the PUMP and earn that post-ride coffee.

Laughter > Watts: We ride hard, but we laugh harder. Whether you’re smashing a PR or just hanging onto a wheel for dear life, do it with a smile.

The Mission:
Show up for yourself, stay for the sisterhood, and let’s show exactly what women-powered logic looks like.

name: Love Riding's 2.0wkg Coffee Ride
description:
Welcome to the Love Riding Club’s Coffee Ride! We meet every Tuesday for a casual, conversational
ride at a pace that falls within most people’s Zone 2 range (average pace between 1.8 – 2.2 wkg). We
are a friendly bunch and conversation is encouraged as it’s a great way to make sure you’re not going
too hard!
Sprinting is encouraged as long as you can make your way back to the group in time.
Tip: If you are new to sprints, it is best to sprint from the back of the pack to take advantage of the draft
and you won’t go out too far ahead of the group!

The lead yellow beacon will maintain the average advertised pace and the sweep red beacon will help
those who fall behind to catch up with the main group. We welcome riders who feel strong or want a
challenge to help the sweep team so please just shout up in the chat!

We tend to run the fence to help keep the group together, this will be relaxed at the sprints.
Please respect the lead beacon and make the effort to stay as close as possible to him/her for the benefit
of the whole group.

We LOVE to ride and we LOVE Coffee Rides! Looking forward to seeing you all on Tuesdays,
whether you’re warming up for a race, recovering, or just getting into cycling and this is at your
challenge level. We welcome you all!

Join us on Facebook to continue the chat, provide feedback and take part in how the club shapes in the
future.
https://www.facebook.com/groups/5437161913060756/

or Join our Zwift Club
Love Riding Club – find us in the club search
Find out events by filtering #loveriding

ADVANCED CATEGORY = 650+

Heart Rate Monitor

name: KfK-Tuesday Pain Train 🚂 [KILOMETER FUER KINDER ❤️]
description:
Alle einsteigen! Jeden Dienstag um 18:30 startet der KfK-Pain Train 🚂 bei KILOMETER FÜR KINDER@ZWIFT. 

Kein gemütlicher Bummelzug, kein Sightseeing-Express - hier geht’s mit Volldampf Richtung Schmerzgrenze 🔥.

Aber keine Angst: Egal, ob Ihr gerade Eure ersten Zwift-Workouts fahrt oder schon ordentlich Druck auf dem Kessel habt - trainiert wird gemeinsam und trotzdem immer in Eurem individuellen Leistungsbereich. Und dank Gummiband bleibt natürlich niemand auf der Strecke!

Also: Flaschen auffüllen, Handtuch bereitlegen und den inneren Schweinehund ignorieren!
Auf dem Fahrplan stehen knackige Intervalle und abwechslungsreiche Belastungen in allen Leistungszonen. Für die Extra-Portion Motivation sorgt ein wenig Spaß im Gruppenchat und das beruhigende Gefühl, dass zusammen leiden einfach weniger weh tut 😜.

Das Ziel unserer Reise?? Gemeinsam stärker werden 💪🏼

Falls Euch das Tempo doch mal zu hoch wird oder ihr einfach entspannt mitrollen und die Community genießen möchtet, auch kein Problem… ERG-Modus aus und ganz locker in den Gummi hängen 👍🏼😊!

👕 „Jersey-Unlock“ für das KfK-Kit ist aktiviert!

⏰ Late-Join bis 19:00 Uhr möglich!

English Version:

All aboard! Every Tuesday at 6:30 p.m., the KfK-Pain Train 🚂 departs from the KILOMETER FÜR KINDER@ZWIFT-Club.

This isn’t a leisurely local train or a sightseeing express—here, we’re heading full steam ahead toward the pain threshold 🔥.

But don’t worry: Whether you’re just starting out with your first Zwift workouts or are already in the thick of it - we train together while still staying within your individual performance zone. And thanks to the “rubber band”, no one gets left behind!

So: Fill up your water bottles, grab a towel, and ignore that inner voice telling you to quit!

On the schedule: intense intervals and varied workouts across all intensity zones. A little fun in the group chat and the comforting feeling that suffering together just hurts less will provide that extra dose of motivation 😜.

The goal of our journey?? To get stronger together 💪🏼

If the pace gets too fast for you or you just want to cruise along and enjoy the community, that’s no problem either… Switch off ERG mode and take it easy 👍🏼😊!

👕 “Jersey Unlock” for the KfK kit is activated!

⏰ Late join is possible until 7:00 p.m.

name: KIRCHMAIR Beginners Race
description:
Die neue Kirchmair x RennRad Rennserie wir jeden Dienstag gefahren. In 10 Rennen könnt ihr auf spannenden Strecken gegeneinander antreten und die Form für das Frühjahr testen. Ein Rennen dauert ca. 45 Minuten und ist eine perfekte kurze und intensive Trainingseinheiten.

Die Auswertung erfolgt über Zwiftpower. Die besten 5 Ergebnisse gehen in die Gesamtwertung mit ein. Es gibt keine Segmentwertungen. Power-Ups (Aerohelm, Draftboost, Feder) werden an jedem Banner zufällig verteilt.

Für die besten Fahrerinnen und Fahrer jeder Kategorie in der Gesamtwertung gibt es jeweils Preise, die vom RennRad Magazin gesponsert werden. Außerdem erhalten die Erstplatzierten jedes Rennens eine kleine Überraschung. RennRad versorgt euch mit den besten Infos zu Radevents, Technik und Training: https://www.radsport-rennrad.de

Wichtig: Um einen Preis zu erhalten, müsst ihr einen Account bei Zwiftpower haben und in unserem Zwiftpower Team angemeldet sein: https://zwiftpower.com/team.php?id=2991

Rennen 1 25.03.: Road to Ruins Reverse
Rennen 2 01.04.: Petite Douleur
Rennen 3 08.04.: London Loop 2 Runden
Rennen 4 15.04.: Danger Noodle
Rennen 5 22.04.: 2018 UCI Worlds Course Short Lap
Rennen 6 29.04.: Yorkshire Double Loops
Rennen 7 06.05.: Itza Climb Finish
Rennen 8 13.05.: Chain Chomper
Rennen 9 20.05.: The Highline Reverse
Rennen 10 27.05.: Glasgow Reverse 10 Runden

Wir wünschen euch viel Erfolg!

name: ZLDR No One Left Behind
description:
Come join ZLDR for a nice go AYOP (at your own pace) event. All participants whether running or walking are encourage to participate. Our leads will be taking this time to walk and chat and basically encourage the heck out of you to just keep moving regardless your pace!

ZLDR is a group of diverse people, from speed demons to walkers, from people just getting to their first 5k to ultra runners. name: 3R PedalPlay EVOLVE Interval Ride [~2.9-3.2 w/kg avg]
description:
This is a 3R Group Ride Event. Your co-operation and teamwork is essential to the success of the ride and we ask that no riders ride off the front of the group. The event is designed as part of 3R’s package of #ProStyleTraining events to assist with the attainment of your training goals and may include intervals over and below the ride average parameters. This is not a race so please follow the leader beacon's (Yellow) instructions and if you are feeling strong, please help the keeper beacon (Red) to assist other riders back to the pack. We welcome good banter and aim to create a fun, social atmosphere for your training. We welcome any feedback on our Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/groups/ClubWorldBicycleRelief/ 

#Team3R #Ride3R #RideRaceRaise #3r

name: VO2sday Micro Race (1 of 5) by Zwift Insider
description:
Welcome to VO2sday - 5 short, back-to-back TT races designed to give you a properly structured VO2 Max workout in a motivating and engaging race!

RESULTS: Final race results combining all 5 events can be found at https://leadoutesports.com/vo2sday/. 

IMPORTANT: You need to create an account at Leadout and link it to your Zwift account to show up in race results.

All races are 4 minutes long. Whoever rides the furthest, wins! Be sure to complete all 5 races so you get a full workout and are included in the overall competition.

Because the goal is for you to hold your max power for the duration of each race, these are set up as mass-start time trial events. Drafting is disabled, so there's no 'sitting in.' Use the best TT frame and wheels you've got. Push as hard as you can for the race duration, then recover and do it again!

Categories are based on your compound score, which takes into account your 5-minute power and body weight, computed as (5-min power in W/kg) * (5-min power in W). Current category setup:

- A: 1600+
- B: 1200-1600
- C: 900-1200
- D: 900 and below

name: Run in the Park Group 5km's'
description:
Join us for a structured 5km progressive workout event, with each group targeting a
specific finish time so you can choose the effort that fits your goals.
-
Every group includes a progressive 5km run workout where the pace increases each
kilometre, finishing with a fast 400m free run to let you open up and push hard to the
line.
-
A warmup and cooldown segment is included, giving a total event distance of 6km
for Groups A, B and C with Groups D and E having a shorter warmup/cooldown
distance to slightly shorten the overall run to 5.4km and 5.6km respectively.
-
Group A: 5km in 20 minutes (600m warmup + 400m cooldown; 6.0km total)
-
Group B: 5km in 25 minutes (600m warmup + 400m cooldown; 6.0km total)
-
Group C: 5km in 30 minutes (600m warmup + 400m cooldown; 6.0km total)
-
Group D: 5km in 35 minutes (400m warmup + 200m cooldown; 5.6km total)
-
Group E: 5km in 40 minutes (200m warmup + 200m cooldown; 5.4km total)
-
Choose the group based on the time you want to run for your progressive 5km (not
including the warmup/cooldown). This is a workout event designed to allow people
to run together, not a race.
-
There is a 10-minute post-event cooldown period for chatting and congratulating
fellow runners
This is a great session for improving your 5km speed, practicing pacing discipline, or
simply enjoying a group workout with structure and purpose.

name: RCC Global Club Ride
description:
WELCOME TO THE RAPHA CYCLING CLUB WORLD WIDE GROUP RIDE.

This is a social group workout; a chance every week for members to get together from around the globe, ride, chat and support each other - it’s run as a group workout session with ‘keep everyone together’ enabled so no matter what your pace you’ll stay in the pack - it’s not a race or competition and open for anyone to join us.

We host 4 rides every week on a Tuesday to suit different time zones around the world (aimed at evenings), join whichever time works best for you.

WHO IS THE RCC?

The Rapha Cycling Club (RCC) is, as the name suggests, Rapha’s Cycling Club. The RCC exists to help connect like minded riders from all over the world, underpinned by Rapha’s products and experiences. We ride together across continents and here united within Zwift.

For more information head to: www.Rapha.cc/rcc

RIDE LEADERS

The rides are led by our friendly team of member ride leaders from around the world. The Leader (who has a yellow beacon over their head) will ride at a steady pace as set by the workout session. Prompts will appear on screen set by the workout designer Matt Rowe so you know what to do throughout the ride. On most occasions we will have a support ride leader (who will also have a beacon), the ride leaders are there to help support you and keep the banter going - to join the chat use the Zwift Companion smartphone app.

ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS

Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. That's right, if you're outputting 100W and another Zwifter is outputting 400W you will stay in exactly the same position relative to each other. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop.

ABOUT THIS WORKOUT

Today's workout contains 4 x 6 minute blocks of Zone 3, with some surges thrown in for good measure! The Zone 3 riding should feel nice and comfortable, however the surges may sting a little. The surges in each block are only 20 seconds long, but at 110% of FTP so require a focused increase in effort .At the end of each 6 minute block, there is a 1 minute 'Free Ride' - this is your chance to turn an endurance based session into something special! Come event day or when riding with friends, it's likely you want some more power for that final sprint to the cafe right? Give it 100% in each 60 second Free Ride section to help you become more explosive! Stress points 45: #Social


WORKOUT DESIGNER

Matt Rowe is the founder of Rowe & King Coaching (www.roweandking.com) with 25 years of cycling experience, coaching amateur cyclists all over the world to achieve their personal goals.

HELPFUL HINT

We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests as the estimated FTP can be inaccurate and make the difficulty level of the workouts too high for your current fitness level.
You can adjust the difficulty of the workout mid-ride if needed, by using the up/down arrows on the left hand side, under the workout details.

HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

name: ROAD TO ZWIFT RACING LEAGUE
description:
Team up. Show up. Race together.

Zwift Racing League is team racing at its best: fast, sweaty, and addictive. Race alongside your teammates every Tuesday, combining teamwork, tactics, and competition with the kind of Type 2 Fun that keeps you coming back for more.

The 2026/27 season features four 6-week rounds from September to April, with new routes, a new format, XP rewards, and exclusive unlocks along the way. Round 1 gets underway on September 22.

YOUR ROAD TO ZRL STARTS HERE

Thinking about racing ZRL? This group ride is designed to show you what it’s all about and help you get ready for the start line.
Ride alongside other Zwifters as we introduce you to team racing, what to expect when you race ZRL, and how to take the next step and join a team.

- B: 1200-1600

name: Torturefest | ITT Climbing League | Alpe | Week 5
description:
ITT Climbing League where elevation is the target not distance. The clock runs from
Pen to virtual banner finish. The routes have been designed to provide lots of world and
climb variations to keep it interesting and challenging.
Week 1 Max Elevation 250 meters
Week 2 Max Elevation 450 meters
Week 3 Max Elevation 650 meters
Week 4 Max Elevation 850 meters
Week 5 when it rarely happens….Alpe Du Zwift
These races are not like the other KOM segment smash races, racing strategy comes to
play. You will have to work different power ranges, manage energy levels and ponder
bike choices.
• No draft regardless of bike.
• No power up’s just you and your watts.
• Weekly distances will fluctuate, for example week 2 could be 15km and week 3 only
10km, elevation is primary focus.
• Category enforced, must wear HRM.
• Zwift Power league in place for weekly and monthly results. Identical setup to Zwift ITT
Racing. Links below, each month the leagues will be reset. An excel backup is available
on Torturefest Cult discord ITT Climbing room.
• Some weeks will have long lead-ins to the climb which creates the bike choice
dilemma; TT bike, climbing bike or mid race bike change?
• What is the intensity of your effort on each climb in a week where the course has
multiple climbs?
• How do you regulate your power on the flat sections before or between climbs?
One week its long drag climbs, next week its multiple smaller climbs…weekly climbing
Russian roulette style.

name: ZZRC Chain Reaction Sub 2
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Chain Reaction Sub 2. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 1.7-1.9 on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be sub 2 .

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicated a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .


We love to have a chat on our rides so join us on our dedicated discord channel for our sub 2
https://discord.gg/RJ3dhbjCEp


TOP TIPS

1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!

2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone

3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app

description:
This event is designed to replicate a prologue, which is a short individual time trial (ITT) held at the beginning of a stage race.

The race will test your ability to go "" full throttle"" for a very short period of time and to push yourself beyond your perceived limits. On occasions, there will be a slightly longer time trial, where you can target hitting your best 20-minute power numbers.

With the same equipment being used, this is the ultimate “Race of truth” as a legendary commentator. Phil Liggett described it.

There are three races on offer, which form part of a series where the overall winner will be the one who completes the three races, with the most accumulated points, which are awarded depending on your finishing position.

Alternatively, you can target one race and go for that individual win; the choice is yours. This event is sponsored by Hyperice.

name: Zwift TT Club Racing - Urumaze
description:
The Time Trial. Cycling’s true leveler - just you and your legs versus everyone else in the field.

Come join Zwift TT Club on Zwift for more Time Trial event information! https://www.zwift.com/clubs/b3d1a903-df49-44eb-9c6f-4ba9f0622efe/home

Join us as we embark on a series of events - each week you will have multiple chances to set your best time on the same route!

Over the course of the series, we’ll be using routes in the region of 15-25km.

Check out Zwiftpower.com after your event to see how well you stack up against the competition!

Don’t forget to check you’re using the fastest bike frame and wheels available to you!

WHAT IS ZWIFT POWER? 
For further information on connecting to Zwift Power check out this support page: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/connecting-to-zwiftpower-SyldRc_4H 

Please note; for your results to show up in Zwift Power you must be using a Heart Rate Monitor (HRM) and be riding on a smart trainer, smart bike, or using a power meter.
